identity: Aye, so this one's a lot like mine.  Real popular among this Exodii node.  It's heavy duty, but as you can see, it's a little less human-like than maybe you're comfortable with.  It's a good, sturdy design, that will keep you safe.  But you'll have to get used to going without most clothing and armor.  The body just isn't made for them.  This is my suggestion.

identity: The prisoners succeeded in their escape and sailed to the mainland.  They found <the_cataclysm> unforgiving and harsh, struggling to survive.  When two of them died in a shootout with a Hell's Raiders caravan, they packed all their possessions and sailed back to the prison, which they transformed into a fortress away from the world…
